correctness.rationale: The exact principal unit-indexed Fourier matrix A_N has positive sign and N^{-1/2} normalization. At local q=p^k, multiplication and Ramanujan sums give AA*=A*A=K and A²=KR, so A is normal. For k>=2, K is the orthogonal block projection ⊕(I_p−J_p/p) on residue fibers modulo p^{k−1}; A vanishes on kerK, is unitary on ranK, and A^4=K. The sums tr A=0 (unit quadratic additive-character cancellation along each fiber, using p odd) and tr A²=tr(KR)=0 (reflection pairs disjoint opposite fibers) force equal multiplicity (p−1)²p^{k−2}/4 for 1,−1,i,−i; 0 has (p−1)p^{k−2}. For k=1 the constant eigenline equals −p^{-1/2}; on its orthogonal complement K=I, A²=R, tr(R|E)=−1 and the classical signed quadratic Gauss sum fixes the claimed s=(b/p)-dependent four multiplicities. The finite Fourier inversion formulas give genuine orthogonal spectral projections. CRT phase splitting e_N(xy)=∏e_{q_j}(b_jx_jy_j) with b_j=(N/q_j)^{-1} modulo q_j gives the full tensor complex eigenvalue multiset, correct multiplicity collisions, rank and nonzero condition number. Independent matrix/projector recomputation checked 16 odd moduli and 10 local projector cases, maximum eigenvalue mismatch 6e-15; these finite checks corroborate but do not replace the all-N proof.

value.rationale: The Euler-unit-indexed compression of the cyclic Fourier transform is a canonical arithmetic spectral operator. Its all-odd-modulus exact complex eigenvalue multiset, Legendre-character phase splitting, explicit orthogonal eigenspace projectors and CRT local twists are an independently useful complete structural classification, not a renaming of known positive concentration eigenvalues or scalar rank. It yields exact singular rank and conditioning as consequences but does not claim general arbitrary principal-minor results, even moduli or any new evaluation of the classical quadratic Gauss sum. The value rests on the phase/eigenspace classification, not the routine rank corollary.

final_claim: For each odd N>=3, the Euler-unit principal compression of the normalized positive DFT has exact complex eigenvalues, multiplicities and orthogonal eigenspace projectors via CRT-twisted prime-power factors; local repeated prime powers have one zero block and four equal fourth-root phase blocks; squarefree factors have an isolated −p^−1/2 eigenvalue and Gauss-character-dependent phase counts.
